messages:
lucy-docs: Quick plan: final sweep for v1 deprecation. Need CI snippets, link redirects, and a tiny migration blurb.

tom-sdk: I will scan SDK and sample apps for client.v1 usage and submit PRs to swap to v2 patterns. Quick grep: `rg "client\.v1" --hidden --glob '!node_modules'`

kai-qa: Proposing CI job docs/snippet-check that runs 3 minimal snippets: python, node, go. Failures saved to artifacts/snippets/1755512345. Include embedding length assert when applicable.

mira-web: Web will add a redirect rule: /v1/* -> /docs/migrate-v2 (temporary 302). Ticket WEB-8910 opened.

deploy-bot: CI pipeline triggered: docs/snippet-check by @kai-qa

kai-qa: Run complete: 2/3 passed. Node example (streaming) failed due to old callback signature. Log: artifacts/snippets/1755512345/node-stream.log

lucy-docs: Ill push a small docs PR to update streaming example and short migration notes. Draft banner: "v1 will retire 2026-05-15. Migrate to v2: /docs/migrate-v2"

tom-sdk: Also adding a one-liner in the SDK CHANGELOG and console.warn in the v1 shim.

lucy-docs: Owners: docs @lucy-docs, SDK @tom-sdk, CI @kai-qa, web @mira-web. Target: merge fixes by EOD tomorrow.

mira-web: Redirect staged to prod at 09:00 UTC once PRs merge.

lucy-docs: Thanks team :sparkles:
